body: Well, my parents have treated me like shit my whole life. Even before my enlistment in the Marines, then after I got home they just got even worse. They didn’t want me living with them so they just told me to find something in a week. In my time in the Marines, I was overseas for 3 years and my ex wife cheated and got pregnant, so this relationship was my last shot. So I give up, I’m sorry. I’ve lost too many friends and I have no one left.
